FN-WKSR9E5-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 102
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/11/2025
House Bill 102 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of local education
agencies to assist students in evaluating dual enrollment courses and in recognizing and
awarding high school credit to a student for the completion of approved dual enrollment courses
at a community college. Additionally, this bill could increase the administrative obligations of
the State Department of Education and the Alabama Community College System to develop
guidelines for the implementation of the provisions of this bill.

FN-WKSR9E5-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 102
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/12/2025
House Bill 102 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy could increase the
administrative obligations of local education agencies to assist students in evaluating dual
enrollment courses and in recognizing and awarding high school credit to a student for the
completion of approved dual enrollment courses at a community college. Additionally, this bill
could increase the administrative obligations of the State Department of Education, the Alabama
Community College System, and the various 4-year institutions of higher education to develop
guidelines for the implementation of the provisions of this bill.

FN-WKSR9E5-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 102
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Representative Jeana Ross
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/14/2025
House Bill 102 as passed the House of Representatives could increase the administrative
obligations of local education agencies to assist students in evaluating dual enrollment courses
and in recognizing and awarding high school credit to a student for the completion of approved
dual enrollment courses at a community college or university. Additionally, this bill could
increase the administrative obligations of the State Department of Education, the Alabama
Community College System, and the various 4-year institutions of higher education to develop
guidelines for the implementation of the provisions of this bill.
